author: AFFiNE
description: Track each episode you’ve watched from all seasons of The Simpsons with this handy checklist. Mark your favorites, note any memorable quotes, and ensure you don’t miss an iconic moment!
md:

 • Favorite Moments – Space to jot down notable quotes or favorite scenes.


 • Rating Option – Personal rating for each episode (optional)
